records.issue_text: The OAuth token endpoint is called using only an enumerable user ID and app slug, without a shared secret or authorization header, leaving access-token retrieval unauthenticated
records.rationale: In refreshOAuthTokens.ts, the fetch to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT sends only `calcomUserId` and `appSlug` in the body with no Authorization header or shared secret, so any party who can reach that endpoint (or the parent app trusting the request) can retrieve access tokens for arbitrary user IDs. The diff contains no authentication mechanism for this call, and the tokens returned are then persisted as credentials. This is a verifiable security gap introduced by the new code.
